findings.claim: 前端方案区分成功空与读取失败，暂存草稿不当当前权威，失败或加载中禁止命令及history恢复，入口guard早于请求键和调用。
findings.evidence: 文件 .evidence/qyh-creator-workflow-read-failure-ui-20261014/proposed-diff-r1.txt diff行：1) `setWorkflowReadState(workflows === null ? "failed" : "ready")`；2) `const activeDraft = preparation && workflowReadState === "ready" ? workflowDrafts[preparation] : undefined;`；3) `if (workflowReadState !== "ready") { setWorkflowError(...); return; }` 在 executeWorkflow 内；4) diff行 `disabled = busy || readUnavailable || ...` 及各按钮 `busy || readUnavailable`。材料明确：null为failed，空[]为合法ready，错误不输出异常/SQL/secret。

findings.claim: 方案保留编辑字段和已发生Receipt及未知请求键，恢复仅从新read成功建立当前状态，原正常流程和旧相邻行为不改。
findings.evidence: 文件 .evidence/qyh-creator-workflow-read-failure-ui-20261014/proposed-diff-r1.txt 计划段落与diff：1) 计划明确“不销毁用户正在编辑的字段或已发生操作Receipt/idempotencyKey”，且“不重置unknown/attempted命令key”；2) `current` prop 仍传 `workflowDrafts[preparation] ?? null`，但 `activeDraft` 仅在 `readState===ready` 时有效，故history useEffect仅在新read成功后运行；3) diff中保留 `{receipt ? <small>回执...</small> : null}` 与 `error` 段，原 `busy || values.title...` 增加 `readUnavailable` 而非删除逻辑。
